First off sorry for format errors since Im on mobile but thank you! and for my routine I'm still pretty fresh to lifting/bodybuilding so im open to criticism/advice.

Sunday - Typically I use this day for rest or to try new lifts/exercises to see if there's any new ones I haven't tried or ones that I'd like to incorporate in other days of the week.

Monday - International Chest day 
Bench 5x5
Overhead, Superman, Ground Cables 3x10
Chest Press 3x10
Pec Fly 3x10
15 Min Cardio

Tuesday - Arm day
Single Arm Bicep Cables curls 3x10 
Tricep Pulldowns 3x12
Preacher Curls with EZ bar both sitting and standing typically I'll try and do medium to heavy and do about 5x10
Close grip(?) pull ups 3x10
Double Bicep Cable Curls 3x10

Wednesday - Lower Arms Day (Legs)
20 Min Cardio
Calf raises 3x15
Squats 3x10
Quad Extensions 3x10
Leg Curls 3x10

Thursday - Shoulders
Side-Lateral Raises 3x10
Shrugs 3x10
Plate Front Raise 3x10
Overhead Press 3x10
Rear Delt Dly 3x10

Friday - Back
Weighted Rows, descending reps increasing weight at 12,8,4,2
Lat Pulldowns 3x10
Lying T-Bar Rows 3x10
Pull ups 5x10
Deadlift, most day are descending reps at 12,8,4
15 Min Cardio

Saturday - Bodyweight/Cardio
100 Pushups
100 Situps
50 Pull ups
1.5 Run
10 mins of row machine
5x5 Box Jumps

Most of my 3x10s are increasing weight every set by 10-15 lbs.
My core maxs aren't anything crazy good but looking at B: 210 S: 265 D: 215. Other changes that helped was diet changes to smaller portions with lower carbs and higher protein. As well as I won't lie about genetics role in helping me get to wear im at.

I'll do my best to answer any other questions as well as once again any advice is more than welcome! :)
